purpose: Show the application entry point, JDBC transaction boundary, and compatibility adapter for execution lifecycle changes
alt_zh: Execution 生命周期服务通过 JDBC 事务更新 execution、target 和 Outbox，并保留 Repository 兼容适配
alt_en: Execution lifecycle service updates execution, targets, and Outbox in a JDBC transaction while retaining a repository compatibility adapter

purpose: Explain bounded worker shutdown and the fact that ownership release also runs after an await timeout
alt_zh: Coordinator 关闭新 reconcile 入口，Worker 最多等待五秒，随后执行所有权释放回调
alt_en: Coordinator closes reconcile admission, workers await for up to five seconds, then the ownership release callback runs
